scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is one family of five who is deeply in debt and does not fulfill the conditions for being granted another loan. I see an undetectable way to temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account, allowing them to qualify for the loan. At the same time, I would abuse the trust of the other customers and of my colleagues. But if I do this, I will be able to prevent the family from selling their second car.
entities: 1 bank employee,5 members of the indebted family,1+ account holder of the other account that could be temporarily redirected,2+ other loyal customers whose trust could be abused but whose accounts would not be directly redirected,2+ bank colleagues whose trust could be abused,I
outcomes: The other account holder's money remains untouched.
The indebted family's account does not receive temporary extra funds.
The indebted family does not qualify for the additional loan.
The indebted family remains under financial strain.
The trust of my other customers is not abused.
I do not commit bank fraud or theft.
The bank's lending rules are followed.
